data.title: PitchBook-NVCA Venture Monitor, Q4 2023
data.summary: Every stage of the US private funding chain contracted at once. Deal value fell from $348.0 billion in 2021 to $170.6 billion in 2023. Exit value reached a decade low of $61.5 billion across an estimated 1,129 events. New fund commitments fell to a six-year low of $66.9 billion across 474 funds, against $169.2 billion in 2021 and $172.8 billion in 2022.
data.citation: PitchBook Data and National Venture Capital Association, Q4 2023 PitchBook-NVCA Venture Monitor, January 2024.
